primary_question: Can target-defined valid public supervision produce a source-held-out content increment beyond position, and is the discriminating information observable in the actual input?

source_geometry_assignment.freeze_before_annotation: Per-source decoded W/H after rotation handling, targetRatioWH and computed free_axis
source_geometry_assignment.validation: Compute maximal legal crop from actual W/H and target ratio; no full-axis substitute or rotation augmentation; orientation counts alone do not establish free-axis coverage
source_geometry_assignment.scope: Mechanism coverage sample, not an estimate of competition domain prevalence

data_contract.selection: Legal public original sources; verify source/session, license, media SHA, rotation, decoded frame and PTS; select without model-error inspection; do not use official or protected data
data_contract.source_split: Freeze source/session assignment before annotation is used for fitting; historically exposed sources development only; pilot is not automatically independent confirmation
data_contract.temporal: Complete original-axis labels from two independent humans; excitingness, summary and unknown kept distinct; preserve per-rater budgets, disagreement and validity; do not convert unknown to zero
data_contract.spatial: Four frames/source: two uniform, two selected by frozen content criteria without model predictions; two blind annotators; native target ratio, retained subjects/relationships, max-window offset first, variable scale separately; retain individual frames and multiple plausible boxes
data_contract.teacher_policy: No teacher box or generated score may be recorded as human GT
data_contract.difficulty_pairs: Within-source ordinary/key-result or incomplete/complete events; diagnosis only, not prevalence calibration or population F estimation

minimal_competition: Source-isolated position/domain control vs same-input compact content readout under matched K
Same legal event in actual static observations vs short continuous process; test human observability before choosing motion representation
Same native frame: center, restored B3, fixed candidate GT oracle, constrained readout; separate candidate geometry from ranking and representation

resource_budget.human_time: Measure a one-source two-rater pilot before extrapolation; no annotation service/channel or paid budget currently provided
resource_budget.formal_training: Not launched; profile and communicate data/control/resource evidence before any formal expansion; planned <=10.5h, timeout11h50m, recoverable checkpoints

gates.before_fitting: Valid identity/PTS/labels, source-session partition, explicit objective, annotator process, fixed comparison and practical gate written before candidate results; sample size justified by pilot source variance and cost
gates.change_observation: Human/controlled baseline cannot separate state under actual input, can with local continuous input
gates.change_representation: Target reliable and visible, current readout cannot fit despite controlled optimization; compare information-preserving readout before encoder expansion
gates.policy_transfer: Fits TRAIN but fails source-held-out evaluation; inspect domain/annotation policy before increasing capacity
gates.promotion: Independent source joint temporal+native crop GT, total deployed parameters<=9B, actual inference profile and new schema validation, then user platform upload with SHA binding

stop: Invalid media-label/PTS mapping, unauthorized data, leakage or resource conflict
Cannot operationalize target or record validity; do not expand ambiguous labels
Repeated fair tests lack source-held-out practical increment and offer no new mechanism
External annotation access unavailable: mark only this dependency, continue independent work
